name: Kago no Tori
source:
"I would ask you to view this with lewd but gentlemanly eyes." 

1983, at a place where gentlemen gather 
Yuumi works as a "room hostess"
These are scenes from the inn of Kagotaku. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE149180.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我请你用淫荡但绅士的眼光来看待这件事。” 

1983年，君子聚集地Yuumi担任“客房服务员”
这些是Kagotaku旅馆的场景。
